value.task: Diagnose one failed PtcRunner run using only immutable evidence. Start with debug.nav/latest-failure {}. Work REPL-style, but follow the returned links only when the incident lacks a material fact. Use return only once, for the final report. Find the earliest component-owned invariant violation. If evidence proves one faulty prelude, return propose-change with exactly these flat keys: decision, run_id, cause, target_environment, target_mission, component_id, function_id, base_source_hash, candidate_source, invariant, evidence, validation_plan. function_id must be the namespace-qualified prelude reference in component/function form. evidence is an array of citation strings. validation_plan is an array of objects having only property and test string keys. candidate_source must be the complete replacement component source. Preserve namespace metadata, public names, documentation, signatures, dependencies, effects, and unrelated behavior. Otherwise return insufficient-evidence with exactly decision, run_id, cause, and missing_evidence.
